## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Docs updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] No new network calls
- [ ] AI apps treated equally: listed alphabetically, no app-specific settings changes
- [ ] Data file shape changes bump the schema version and add a migration
- [ ] No real personal data in code, tests, or screenshots
